subject: [PATCH v3 09/18] selftests/mm: add khugepaged completion barrier helper

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch adds a completion barrier helper to the khugepaged selftest, which allows tests to drive the khugepaged daemon in a step-by-step manner. The helper ensures that the daemon completes one full scan pass before proceeding, and it uses sysfs settings to wake the daemon when necessary. This change also updates the thp_write_settings function to only write changes to khugepaged settings, rather than writing all settings every time. The goal is to improve the reliability of race and functional tests for khugepaged.
